profile.name: Masterflex L/S 蠕动泵
profile.description: 一款实验室蠕动泵，通过滚轮挤压软管实现液体输送，可连续运行或按设定转数运行，常用于试剂传输、循环、灌装和一般流体处理。
profile.description_en: A laboratory peristaltic pump that moves liquid by compressing flexible tubing. It can run continuously or for a specified number of revolutions, and is commonly used for reagent transfer, recirculation, dispensing, and general fluid handling.
